description.en: Same as RemoveParty_Message, but without fading/stopping the current BGM (passes 0 for both the fade and wait durations).
Param ID of the character to remove from the party.
Whether to reset the member's status.
Optional; when true, removes the member without locking their slot (defaults to false).
No explicit return statement — Squirrel functions implicitly return null.

example.code:
// Remove a party member with the departure presentation, without fading the BGM
RemoveParty_Message_NoFadeBGM("para_cp0009", false);
